description: JavaScript code for TinyMCE plugin to insert and update HTML tables with form-based configuration, including styling and attributes.

methods.name: insertTable
methods.description: Main function to insert or update an HTML table based on form inputs, with validation and styling.

methods.name: makeAttrib
methods.description: Helper function to create HTML attribute string with proper encoding.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the table dialog, populates form fields based on existing table or defaults.

methods.name: changedSize
methods.description: Updates style object with new width and height from form inputs.

methods.name: changedBackgroundImage
methods.description: Updates style object with new background image URL.

methods.name: changedBorder
methods.description: Updates style object with new border width.

methods.name: changedColor
methods.description: Updates style object with new background and border colors.

methods.name: changedStyle
methods.description: Parses style string and updates form fields accordingly.
